## Highlights
### New
- On Mac, closing a Quick Window that opened over another app, from one of its links or the New Quick Window shortcut, takes you back to that app. Crest's other windows stay behind that app while the Quick Window is open.
### Fixed
- On Mac, a Quick Window that a link from another app or the New Quick Window shortcut opens appears over the app you're using, on the display you're using it on, instead of over another app's window. Links in Crest's own Settings open over Crest.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
